verdict.rationale: A public register portal could plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant or chatbot, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents search, publication submission and the Bilanz-Navigator, which is a guidance tool, not an AI assistant. Nothing shows a built-in AI assistant that tasks can be delegated to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
